acceptance_criteria: Add a Phase 1 decision engine entry point that evaluates length and width measurements against resolved product spec nominal values and tolerances.
Emit length and width RuleResult evidence with raw inch points, nominal value, tolerance bounds, unit, aggregate/min/max evidence, and out-of-tolerance point indexes.
Use all-points-must-pass as a conservative bootstrap shadow assumption while the final SOP aggregate method remains open.
Return BLOCKED before shadow PASS/NG when product spec, calibration, or required geometry evidence lacks authority or is incomplete.
Return shadow NG with LENGTH_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE and/or WIDTH_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE when any Phase 1 point is outside tolerance.
Return shadow PASS only when both length and width rule results pass; production authority remains false and SOP_TOLERANCE_APPROVAL_MISSING remains an authority blocker.
Add reason-code registry coverage and focused tests for blocked, PASS, NG, evidence payload, and all-points bootstrap behavior.
Update project docs and gate/handoff evidence to make clear this is not QC-approved production tolerance authority.
